messages:
Ben Torres: Hi folks — my dependent's ER claim was denied. Carrier says SSN/name mismatch. I uploaded the SSN card but they keep rejecting it. Any idea what's wrong?
Samira Khan: Sorry you're hitting this, Ben. Can you paste the carrier denial EOB IDs here (no SSNs in channel) and confirm what name/format you submitted for the dependent? Example: 'Maria L. Torres' vs 'Maria Luisa Torres'.
Ben Torres: EOB IDs: CLM-982344 and CLM-982345. I enrolled my stepdaughter as 'Maria Torres' in the portal but her SSN card shows 'Maria Luisa Torres'. I uploaded a photo of the SSN card to the secure portal earlier today as "1801234567_ben_maria_ssn.jpg".
BenefitsAdmin: Thanks. Carrier rejections for matching usually happen when the name on enrollment doesn't exactly match SSA records. We can submit an enrollment maintenance/correction to the carrier and request reprocessing of the claims, but they will often ask for one of the following: SSA confirmation letter (A-number/SSN proof), birth certificate, or a signed affidavit if documentation is delayed.
BenefitsAdmin: Next steps: 1) Upload the SSN card + birth certificate (or passport) to the secure portal: https://hr.redwood.com/secure-upload and choose "Dependent Data Correction". 2) In the portal notes include the EOB IDs and explain name variation. 3) Reply here when uploaded so we can escalate. Do NOT post SSNs in Slack.
People Ops Bot: Reminder: never post PII in channels. Use secure upload link: https://hr.redwood.com/secure-upload.
Ben Torres: Uploaded "1801234567_ben_maria_ssn.jpg" and "1801234567_ben_maria_bc.pdf" to the portal just now, notes include EOB IDs and the exact name from SSN card.
ClaimsTeam: Got it. We'll prepare an enrollment correction to the carrier and attach the docs. Carrier turnaround for re-adjudication is typically 7-14 business days. We'll request urgent review due to paid-out claims potentially being refunded.
ClaimsTeam: One more ask: if any claims have been paid to the provider already, please send us the provider remittance IDs (if you have them) or the dates of service. That speeds up reprocessing.
Ben Torres: Dates of service: 2026-08-02 and 2026-08-05 at St. Vincent Pediatrics. No remittance IDs on the patient statement.
Samira Khan: Payroll/Tax note: PayrollOps — Ben's dependent name in payroll file may also need sync if benefits carrier updates. If any dependent SSN updates occur, please confirm whether W-2 or other reporting needs adjustment.
PayrollOps: Noted. If the carrier issues retro changes that affect premiums or tax reporting we will coordinate any necessary adjustments and let Ben know if an amended W-2 is needed. Typically name corrections don't change tax amounts unless SSN was wrong in payroll.
BenefitsAdmin: We'll submit the correction package to the carrier today and include a request to reprocess CLM-982344/982345. If carrier asks for SSA verification letter, we will request Ben to obtain a letter from SSA (SSA Form LTR combined or in-person SSA printout) — we can accept that as final proof.
Ben Torres: Appreciate it. If carrier still rejects because of the missing middle name, can I provide a notarized affidavit?
BenefitsAdmin: Yes — a notarized affidavit explaining the alias/short name is acceptable as supplemental documentation while awaiting SSA letter, but carriers prefer primary documentation (birth cert/SSA letter). We'll submit the affidavit if needed.
ClaimsTeam: We'll update this thread when carrier responds. Expect a status update within 5 business days.
Ben Torres: Thanks team — looking forward to the update.
People Ops Bot: For record: upload reference IDs: 1801234567_ben_maria_ssn.jpg, 1801234567_ben_maria_bc.pdf. Use secure portal for any additional docs.
